notes: Recaptured at the final working-tree state after all UI fix lanes landed; head is the current committed HEAD the pixels are built on.

Loaded/GEX/popover frames use setupApiMocks, loginAsTestUser and setupNiftyReportMocks plus enriched report, tape, walls and movers route payloads so no window is left in Loading or NO DATA; the app renders the real UI from those seeded responses.

Capture asserts real loaded data: spot 22,363.35 consistent across hero and ALL STATS, STALE 44d (never 64142m), EMA9 overlay legend visible, and at 390 both chain cue pills fully inside the viewport with the 16px reserved cue lane.
GEX is selected by a real Playwright click; the active yellow fill is checked via transition-property none and a distinct background from the inactive Futures tab before the screenshot.
loading and error are deliberately mocked with Playwright route handlers; no live server state can produce them on demand.
